title: A usage window with no `used` reads as 0% — which also puts a spent account first in the routing order
head: 6791aa99ba38be542b0d29de48a23d8bb2007705
testCommands: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui ./...
testsAdded: internal/gui/tests/usage-no-reading.test.cjs: a window that didn't say used shows its text, not a percentage
internal/provider/plugin_usage_absent_test.go: TestAWindowWithoutUsedIsNoAllowance (compiles on the base too: only the latter window is in the allowance)
unverifiedBoundaries: The routing outcome is asserted through quotaOfPlugin/allowanceOf (a window without used is no Limit, an account whose windows all say nothing has no Allowance), not through a live gateway request over the vendor's HTTP.
The meter fix is browser-tested on fixture JSON; no real plugin on this host reports a window without used.
The check-in prefix is tested through the plugin host's fake provider (an outcome "yes" with a message); no real vendor's unrecognised outcome was seen.
Playwright is not vendored in this repo; the JS test was run with the machine's playwright 1.64.1 (NODE_PATH), Chromium and WebKit.
The Go internal/gui package tests were not run; the app.js change is covered by the browser test, go vet and the three builds.

internal/plugin TestPluginSOCKSProxy: proxyconnect 502 / connection refused for its SOCKS proxy on this host — same on clean 01468003.
